author: Inside Edition
description: An 8-year-old boy was fishing in a Pennsylvania lake when he caught a piranha. The very name can cause one to conjure up an image of terrifying teeth. The boy, Seamus Coffey, spoke with Inside Edition's Justin Finch. Piranhas are not native to U.S. waters. Wildlife officials say the fish may have been a pet in a home aquarium that was illegally released into the lake. The boy's father says the youngster has a new nickname after his wild catch: Famous Seamus.
title: 8-Year-Old Boy Catches Piranha While Fishing

author: Inside Edition
description: Police say a dilapidated house in Philadelphia is a house of horrors. The residence was home to a father, Ray Horsch, who died last year, and his son Eugene. Forensic investigators in hazmat suits found gun parts, suspicious chemicals, and urns with cremated human remains, according to authorities. They also say they found a video depicting the apparent torture and death of two missing young women. Police fear there could be more victims. Eugene Horsch's lawyer says he is innocent, adding that investigators are barking up the wrong tree when it comes to the missing women.
title: Missing Women Linked To What Cops Call A 'House Of Horrors' In Philadelphia

author: Inside Edition
description: Lindsay Clancy's last text messages were revealed in her murder trial. The texts were sent in an hour before she strangled her three young children. The texts occurred while Clancy sent her then-husband, Patrick Clancy, on errands. He returned to find their children strangled with exercise bands. The mother then jumped from a window and is now paralyzed. Lindsay has pleaded not guilty, saying she was suffering postpartum psychosis.
title: Lindsay Clancy's Final Text Massages Revealed At Her Murder Trial

author: Inside Edition
description: Rescue workers brought a man and his dog ashore after they were trapped in the middle of a raging flood. The man was actor Martin Kove, who starred as the villain of the "Karate Kid" movies and the Netflix show "Cobra Kai." The 80-year-old says he was with his girlfriend and 12-week-old puppy Winston when rising flood waters surrounded his Tennessee home. A rescue team was able to reach the house by boat and bring the family to dry land.
title: 'Cobra Kai' Star Martin Kove And His Dog Rescued From Flood

author: Inside Edition
description: Abigail Dye is training for a marathon and while on a run in Houston, she says two good Samaritans drove up and stopped her with a dire warning. They told Dye that a man was chasing her. After Veronica Ontiveros and her nephew Justin Schmitgen alerted Dye, the jogger captured video of the man. Dye says when she turned to face the man, he quickly walked in the opposite direction.
title: Jogger Says Good Samaritans Warned Her That She Was Being Chased

author: Inside Edition
description: The family members of slain United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson came face to face with Luigi Mangione. The anguished family members heard Mangione admit to stalking Thompson and shooting him in the back on his way to a shareholders conference in Manhattan. Mangione faces possible life in prison when he next appears in federal court for sentencing on December 19th. As Mangione pleaded guilty, a handful of Mangione supporters were calling for his freedom.
title: Luigi Mangione Pleads Guilty To Federal Stalking Charges In United Healthcare CEO Killing

author: Inside Edition
description: What they did was find a needle in a haystack! The NYPD's Aviation unit was  responding to a 911 call from a scared woman who said she was lost in a wooded area in Brooklyn. While the aircraft they use is outfitted with the best searching technology, they tell WCBS, they didn't need it for this mission. However, there was a problem getting her out of the woods. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Woman Rescued From Woods By NYPD Aviation Unit

author: Inside Edition
description: Watch your step in the ocean because experts say stingrays are on the attack this year. Beaches in California are reporting twice as many stingray incidents as last year. Officials say warmer temperatures are causing the creatures to stay closer to shore. Their covert way of protecting themselves is making them hard to spot. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Stingray Attacks On The Rise At California's Beaches

author: Inside Edition
description: Spanish authorities and emergency crews removed the remains of the Aragón region's first three kings as a wildfire has spread across the area. The remains were taken to the provincial museum of Huesca, located 50 miles south of the 11th century monastery where they were located for their protection until conditions improve, local politicians announced. Spain's Civil Guard said on Thursday that one person had been detained on suspicion of starting the wildfire.
title: Wildfires Cause Spain to Remove Remains of 11th Century Kings from Monastery

author: Inside Edition
description: Gunman John Hinckley Jr was overpowered by Secret Service agents after shooting former President Ronald Reagan. Hinckley was motivated by his obsession with movie star Jodie Foster. Now, 46 years later, Hinckley sent the 63-year-old  actress a message. He spoke out on a podcast with Mark Joseph, producer of the 2024 movie "Reagan," which will be re-released on September 25th. The interview took a sinister turn when Hinckley admitted he considered shooting Foster instead of the president.
title: John Hinkley Jr. Speaks Out 45 Years After Shooting Ronald Reagan To Impress Jodie Foster

description: The white-knuckle rescue took place six stories off the ground in Turkiye.
title: Women Use Ironing Board To Rescue Stranded Cat #shorts
